leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a parent component that will manage shared state for multiple child components.
Implement state variables in the parent component using the useState hook with TypeScript types.
Construct callback functions in the parent component to update the shared state.
Pass the shared state values as props from parent to child components.
Pass callback functions as props from parent to child components to enable state updates.
Invoke callback functions from child components to trigger state updates in the parent.
Access and display the shared state values within child components via props.
Control the flow of data by ensuring state updates only occur through parent-provided callbacks.
Utilize TypeScript interfaces to define prop types for components receiving shared state and callbacks.
Apply the lifting state up pattern to synchronize multiple UI elements with a single source of truth.
Modify child components to become controlled components that receive all necessary data via props.
Return a complete React component tree where state is properly lifted and managed at the appropriate level.
